channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Zanin abre hipótese de eleição única no RJ para sucessão de Castro
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin voted for a direct election to choose Claudio Castro’s successor as governor of Rio de Janeiro, leaving open whether it will be a single election in 2026 or two (one for an interim governor and another for the 2027 term). He stated Castro’s resignation aimed to avoid TSE impeachment and enable an indirect election, but that does not nullify existing legal consequences. Minister Alexandre de Moraes signaled support for direct elections and suggested June 21 as a possible date for the supplementary election.

item.title: Zanin defende eleição direta no RJ e sugere pleito único
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Cristiano Zanin advocated for direct elections to fill the interim governorship of Rio de Janeiro, proposing a single vote. The Court will decide the selection model for the next state governor by year-end. Zanin reaffirmed his support for direct elections as a means to ensure legitimacy in the interim office.

item.title: Izalci Lucas pede sessão com pauta única para votar veto da dosimetria
item.description: Senator Izalci Lucas (PL-DF) advocated for a special session of the National Congress with a single agenda item to vote on overturning the presidential veto of the dosimetry bill (PL 2.162/2023), approved in December 2025. He argued that including other matters, such as the reading of the Banco Master CPI, would distract from the main issue and jeopardize the vote on penalties related to the January 8, 2023, attacks on the Three Powers. Izalci said he has consulted with party leaders and believes the majority will support overturning the presidential veto.

item.title: Favorito na disputa por vaga no TCU, Odair Cunha terá 6 concorrentes
item.description: Deputy Odair Cunha (PT-MG) is the frontrunner to fill the TCU vacancy following the retirement of Minister Aroldo Cedraz, backed by 10 parties and Chamber President Hugo Motta. He faces six rivals nominated by other parties, including Soraya Santos (PL), Elmar Nascimento (União Brasil) and Danilo Forte (PSDB). The hearing will take place in the CFT on Monday (Apr 13) and the secret plenary vote on Tuesday (Apr 14).

item.title: Em tom de campanha, Pacheco critica Zema por tempo para entregar obras de hospitais em MG: 'Paralisia crônica'
item.description: Senator Rodrigo Pacheco (PSB) criticized former Governor Romeu Zema's administration for delays in regional hospital construction in Minas Gerais, calling it 'chronic paralysis' and a 'waste of resources' during a Senate speech on World Health Day. He argued the delays overload major hospitals and require scientific planning and responsible regionalization. In response, current Governor Simões blamed the delays on the administration of Zema's predecessor, Fernando Pimentel (PT), and invited Pacheco to visit Minas Gerais to see ongoing works.

item.title: Apesar de críticas, cacique Raoni declara apoio a Lula na eleição de outubro
item.description: Indigenous leader Raoni Metuktire declared his support for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s re-election in the October 2026 Brazilian elections, despite criticizing Lula’s approval of oil exploration near the Amazon River mouth. Raoni praised Lula for homologating around twenty indigenous territories and significantly reducing deforestation, contrasting him with Jair Bolsonaro, who froze demarcations and worsened environmental destruction. The indigenous movement, largely favoring Lula, will march in Brasília under the slogan 'Demarca, Lula!'.

item.title: Equipe econômica tenta travar “pauta-bomba” com custo bilionário
item.description: Lula's economic team is seeking to block congressional approval of spending-increasing proposals without clear funding sources, such as a bill to expand resources for the Unified Social Assistance System (Suas), projected to cost R$36 billion over four years and up to R$100 billion over a decade. Other initiatives, including pension changes for health agents and adjustments to the Simples Nacional tax regime, are also seen as 'fiscal bombs' threatening fiscal targets.

item.title: Novo exige que candidatos ao Senado defendam impeachment no STF
item.description: The Novo party approved Resolution 72 of 2026, requiring its Senate candidates to commit to supporting the impeachment of Supreme Court ministers for responsibility crimes, abuse of authority, and other conduct deemed incompatible with office. The resolution also bans coalitions with the PT, Psol and their federations, as well as campaigns for null, blank, or votes for candidates from other parties. Senator Eduardo Girão (Novo-CE) defended the rule as necessary to restore the separation of powers and combat what he calls 'relative democracy'.

item.title: “Vou governar para você também”, diz Flávio a indígena
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a pre-candidate for President, was confronted by an Indigenous woman in the National Congress on Wednesday, the 8th. She accused him of being a 'sellout' and 'colonizer', criticizing his stance on Indigenous peoples and referencing a prior statement. The protest took place as he walked through the Chamber of Deputies, with the woman shouting 'no amnesty'.

item.title: Veto de Lula ao PL da Dosimetria completa três meses, mas Alcolumbre...
item.description: President Lula fully vetoed, on January 8, the dosimetry bill approved by the Senate on December 17, which would have reduced penalties for those convicted of attempted coup. The veto has now been in place for three months and remains under congressional review, with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre facing pressure to schedule a vote on overriding or sustaining the veto. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Alcolumbre diz que quer votar veto de Lula ao PL da Dosimetria 'o mais rápido possível' e vai combinar data com Motta
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre said he will talk to Chamber President Hugo Motta to schedule a National Congress session to vote on President Lula's veto of the Dosimetria bill as soon as possible. The bill, approved at the end of 2024, would reduce sentences for Jair Bolsonaro and others convicted of the January 8, 2023, coup attempts, but was fully vetoed by Lula in January 2025. Overturning the veto requires 257 votes in the Chamber and 41 in the Senate.

item.title: O conselho de Lula a Alexandre de Moraes no caso Master
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said in an interview that he advised Minister Alexandre de Moraes not to let his reputation be tarnished, noting that efforts are underway to stain Moraes’s image due to his dignified role during the January 8 events.

item.title: Lula sanciona lei que regulamenta a profissão de doula
item.description: President Lula signed into law the regulation of the doula profession in Brazil, establishing a minimum 120-hour training requirement and mandating that public and private hospitals accept the presence of doulas during prenatal care, childbirth, and postpartum. The law aims to reduce obstetric violence, cesarean rates, and women's suffering, while improving childbirth experience without replacing medical functions.

item.title: Cid Gomes diz que “é muito constrangedor” não votar em Ciro no Ceará
item.description: Senator Cid Gomes (PSB-CE) said it would be 'very embarrassing' not to vote for his brother Ciro Gomes (PSDB-CE) if he ran for governor of Ceará in 2026, but reiterated his support for current governor Elmano de Freitas (PT-CE) and the PSB's goal of electing federal and state deputies. Cid stated he does not intend to run for the Senate, despite being favored by Camilo Santana, and that he would support Ciro for president nationally, but would only back Lula's re-election if there were no other alternative.

item.title: PL dos apps: Boulos critica relatório e diz que vai conversar com Lula para governo fechar posição
item.description: Guilherme Boulos (PSOL), Minister of the General Secretariat of the Presidency, criticized the report by Deputy Augusto Coutinho (Republicanos-PE) on app-based work regulation, citing setbacks and deteriorations, such as maintaining the R$8.50 minimum per delivery and lacking night and holiday pay premiums. He said he will speak with President Lula and Minister Luiz Marinho to unify the government’s stance on the issue, which has become a priority in the first half of 2025 ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Fachin pede destaque e caso sobre gratuidade na Justiça do Trabalho irá ao plenário físico
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Edson Fachin requested a review of the labor justice gratuity case, postponing the decision on eligibility criteria. Previously, five justices supported a R$ 5,000 income cap based on the 2017 Labor Reform, while Fachin argues self-declared insufficiency suffices. The full Court will decide in a physical session, with no date set for the agenda.

item.title: Deputados oficializam candidatura a ministro do TCU; Odair Cunha, do PT, tem apoio de 12 siglas
item.description: Federal deputies have formally announced their candidacies for the vacant minister position at the Tribunal de Contas da União (TCU), left by Aroldo Cedraz in February. Odair Cunha (PT-MG) stands out with the backing of 12 political parties. Other candidates include Soraya Santos (PL-RJ), Elmar Nascimento (União Brasil-BA), Hugo Leal (PSD-RJ), Danilo Forte (PP-CE), Gilson Daniel (Podemos-ES) and Adriana Ventura (Novo-PS).

item.title: Ministros do STF fazem campanha para Jorge Messias de olho em apoio futuro; saiba qual ala ganha
item.description: STF ministers are campaigning for Jorge Messias’ Senate approval, each faction seeking to gain a future ally on the Court. The faction led by Gilmar Mendes and Cristiano Zanin, opposed to President Edson Fachin, is mobilizing support for Messias with greater internal and external political articulation, while Fachin’s faction, backed by André Mendonça and Kassio Nunes Marques, aims to recover from its weakening after the Banco Master scandal. Despite numerical parity, the Mendes-Zanin faction speaks louder due to its influence.

item.title: O aceno de Alcolumbre a bolsonaristas sobre sessão para derrubar o veto de Lula ao PL da Dosimetria
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) said he intends to convene 'as soon as possible' a joint session of Congress to override President Lula's veto on a bill that would reduce penalties for those involved in the January 8, 2023 attacks, known as the Dosimetria Bill. Overriding the veto requires an absolute majority in both chambers (257 deputies and 41 senators). Alcolumbre stated he has been in talks with Chamber President Hugo Motta, calling the matter 'extremely important'.

item.title: Hélio Negão é excluído pelo PL de disputa por vaga ao TCU; veja lista de indicados
item.description: Federal deputy Hélio Lopes (PL), known as Hélio Negão, was excluded from the PL's list of nominees for a vacancy at the Federal Court of Accounts (TCU), despite claiming he had spoken with Jair Bolsonaro about the matter. The party's official nomination went to deputy Soraya Santos (RJ), submitted by PL leader Sóstenes Cavalcante. Other parties also submitted their candidates, including Danilo Forte (PSDB/Cidadania), Hugo Leal (PSD), and Elmar Nascimento (União Brasil).

item.title: Papo Antagonista: O Elo entre Lula, Moraes e o Caso Master
item.description: In Papo Antagonista, it was discussed that President Lula advised Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to recuse himself from potential judgments regarding the Banco Master case, due to an alleged contract between the financial institution and a law firm linked to the minister. Lula reportedly suggested the recusal to avoid conflicts of interest.

item.title: STF marca o julgamento de ação de Tabata contra Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) will rule between April 17 and 28 on a defamation lawsuit filed by Deputy Tabata Amaral against Eduardo Bolsonaro over his 2021 criticisms of a bill on sanitary pad distribution. Justice Alexandre de Moraes is the rapporteur, after Justice Dias Toffoli had initially dismissed the case. The outcome hinges on whether Bolsonaro’s remarks were connected to his legislative function.

item.title: Alcolumbre sinaliza votação do veto da dosimetria de penas do 8/1 e diz que quer sessão 'o mais rápido possível'
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre signaled he wants to hold a joint session as soon as possible to vote on the presidential veto of the 8 January sentencing bill, following pressure from opposition senators. The bill, vetoed by Lula for violating constitutional principles, would prevent cumulative sentencing for similar crimes and ease prison regime progression. Opposition and Centrão are pushing for a quick vote, while the government seeks to delay it.

item.title: Flávio é criticado por indígena e diz que governará para ela também
item.description: Senator and presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) was confronted by an Indigenous woman at the National Congress, who called him a 'colonizer' and 'sellout' and shouted 'no amnesty'. He responded by saying he would 'liberate Indigenous peoples' and govern 'for you too', then blew her a kiss as he entered his car. The incident followed his announcement of Soraya Santos as the PL’s nominee to the TCU and occurred amid a CPAC speech where he framed Brazil’s rare minerals as a solution for the Americas.

item.title: Filme sobre Bolsonaro estreia em 11 de setembro de 2026
item.description: The film 'Dark Horse', starring Jim Caviezel as Jair Bolsonaro, is set to premiere on September 11, 2026 — a date marking both the 9/11 attacks and Bolsonaro’s 2025 STF conviction. The movie depicts key moments from his 2018 campaign, including the stabbing in Juiz de Fora, and is directed by Cyrus Nowrasteh with a script by federal deputy Mario Frias. The timing has sparked discussion over its political symbolism and electoral implications.

item.title: Jornalista critica Bolsonaro ao entrevistar Lula
item.description: Journalist Eduardo Moreira, founder of ICL Notícias, criticized Jair Bolsonaro during an interview with President Lula, stating that governments that do not investigate corruption, like Bolsonaro’s, hide schemes that later worsen. Moreira cited the Banco Master case, liquidated in November 2025 and linked to Roberto Campos Neto, and the INSS fraud scheme investigated by the Federal Police in April 2025, which led to the resignation of Minister Carlos Lupi. Lula blames Campos Neto for the Master case and called the bank the 'egg of the serpent' of the previous government.

item.title: É #FAKE mensagem de WhatsApp do TSE cobrando dinheiro para 'regularizar pendências eleitorais'; trata-se de golpe
item.description: Fake WhatsApp messages impersonate the TSE to trick users into paying alleged electoral debts via PIX, using urgent language and threats of public service restrictions. The TSE confirms it does not conduct collections through this channel and warns the public to disregard the scam, which aims to steal personal data and commit financial fraud.

item.title: Vaias e apoio: Flávio Bolsonaro enfrenta turbulências em visita à Câmara
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's pre-candidate for president, faced mixed reactions during a visit to the Chamber of Deputies, with opponents shouting 'no amnesty' and supporters chanting 'my president'. He responded calmly, smiling, blowing kisses, and making heart gestures, avoiding direct confrontation.

item.title: Autor de ação sobre delações defende julgamento, apesar de ‘timing’ do Caso Master
item.description: Lenio Streck, the jurist behind the ADPF seeking to impose stricter limits on plea bargains, defended the need for the STF to judge the action, despite criticism over the timing linked to a potential plea deal by Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master. He argued that postponing it indefinitely would prevent any progress, as there will always be another issue to delay action. The ADPF was filed in December 2021 and revived by Minister Alexandre de Moraes in April 2026, raising concerns about possible conflicts of interest due to Banco Master’s multimillion-dollar contract with the law firm of Moraes’ wife.

item.title: Ação de Tabata Amaral contra Eduardo Bolsonaro no STF ganha, enfim, data para ser julgada
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) has set a date to rule on the criminal action filed by Deputy Tabata Amaral against former Deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro for defamation. The case stems from offensive statements made by Bolsonaro against the parliamentarian and will be judged by the Full Court. The article is exclusive to subscribers of the publishing outlet.

item.title: Guilherme Mello será o novo secretário-executivo do Planejamento
item.description: Guilherme Mello has been confirmed as the new executive secretary of the Ministry of Planning and Budget, succeeding Gustavo Guimarães. He departs from the Economic Policy Secretariat at the Finance Ministry, which will be led by Débora Freire, the first woman to hold the position. Mello has also been nominated to chair the Board of Directors of Petrobras.

item.title: Prefeitos convocam 5 presidenciáveis para sabatina na Marcha a Brasília
item.description: The National Confederation of Municipalities (CNM) invited five leading presidential pre-candidates to participate in a sabatina during the 27th March to Brasília in Defense of Municipalities, scheduled for May 19–21. The event will feature individual one-hour panels focusing on critical municipal pressures: health, social assistance, education, and public finances, with candidates urged to sign a commitment document to municipal priorities.

item.title: Castro posa com Flávio Bolsonaro em dia de julgamento no STF
item.description: Former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) met with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at the party's national headquarters in Brasília on the same day the STF was reviewing the model for a temporary mandate election. The meeting took place amid political coordination within the PL, as both are prominent figures of the party's Bolsonarist faction.

item.title: Líder da oposição pede a Lula demissão do diretor-geral da PF
item.description: The leader of the opposition in the Chamber of Deputies, Cabo Gilberto Silva (PL-PB), filed a request urging President Lula to dismiss Andrei Rodrigues as director-general of the Federal Police. The lawmaker argues the move is urgently needed due to alleged shortcomings in the PF’s leadership, though the full details of the request were not disclosed in the report.

item.title: Flavio Bolsonaro abandona Hélio Negão, lança deputada para TCU e nega acordo com PT
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (RJ) withdrew his support from Deputy Hélio Lopes' candidacy for the Federal Court of Accounts (TCU) and orchestrated the PL party's nomination of Deputy Soraya Santos (RJ) for the position. The decision was made on April 8, 2026, and the senator denied any agreement with the PT regarding the nomination.

item.title: Fux se posiciona por voto secreto em ação sobre eleição indireta no RJ
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Luiz Fux advocated for secret voting in the trial defining the rules for Rio de Janeiro's indirect gubernatorial election. The Court is currently evaluating whether the governor will be chosen by Alerj legislators (indirect election) or by direct popular vote. The ruling will significantly influence the political dynamics in the state of Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro anuncia apoio a Soraya Santos (PL-RJ) na disputa por vaga do TCU
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for the presidency, announced his support for Deputy Soraya Santos (PL-RJ) for the open position at the Federal Court of Accounts (TCU). As a result, the candidacy of Hélio Lopes (PL-RJ) was withdrawn from the selection process.

item.title: “Rio virou Gotham City”, diz advogado do PSD contra eleição indireta
item.description: PSD lawyer Thiago Fernandes Boverio compared the possibility of an indirect election for Rio de Janeiro's temporary mandate to electing the Joker instead of Batman, saying it would be 'easier to elect the Joker than Batman'. The remark was made during oral arguments at the STF, which is deciding on the validity of the indirect election.

item.title: Governo envia esta semana PL sobre fim da escala 6x1
item.description: The federal government will send to Congress this week a bill to reduce the weekly workweek without reducing wages, ending the 6x1 work schedule. President Lula defends the proposal as a result of productivity gains from technology and as a measure for social reeducation and mental health, allowing sector-specific adaptations through collective bargaining.

item.title: Governo vê crise dos combustíveis pior que na pandemia e mira fertilizantes
item.description: The Brazilian government assesses that the fuel crisis could be more severe and prolonged than during the pandemic due to the destruction of oil production infrastructure in the Middle East, with potential impacts on fertilizers, given Brazil's heavy reliance on imports and the essential role of gas in fertilizer production. Technical teams are discussing new measures to mitigate immediate effects, taking into account the October election calendar and the seasonal window for fertilizer demand in the second half of the year.

item.title: Luisa Mell critica vídeo de paca preparada por Janja: “Irresponsável”
item.description: Animal rights activist Luisa Mell criticized a video of First Lady Janja Lula da Silva preparing paca for President Lula, calling it irresponsible for encouraging the consumption of wild animals, even if legally sourced. She argued the video could stimulate illegal hunting and questioned the ethics of captive breeding of wild species, emphasizing the paca’s ecological role in seed dispersal and its low reproductive rate. Mell demanded transparency and proof of legal certification for the animal’s origin.

item.title: Santana critica Sidônio e chama comunicação de Lula de “cesta de Natal”
item.description: Former PT strategist João Santana criticized the Lula government's communication, comparing it to a 'Christmas basket' that focuses only on announcing deliveries without building a consistent narrative. He argued the issue is structural and predates the current Secom leadership, reflecting a failure to connect policies with the population's desire for hope and dreams beyond material gains.

item.title: “Treine, seu puto!”: Fala de Lula vira trend no TikTok
item.description: A remark by President Lula, responding to criticism about his fitness routine at age 80, went viral on TikTok with the phrase 'Train, you jerk!'. The audio sparked a trend featuring workout clips, satirical edits, and participation from deputy Orlando Silva, who linked physical training to revolutionary struggle and public health. Lula also referenced conspiracy theories about being a '4th clone' and emphasized the need for physical and mental readiness to drive social change.

item.title: A dura crítica de Luisa Mell ao almoço com carne de paca que Janja serviu a Lula
item.description: Luisa Mell criticized the Easter lunch in which Janja served paca meat, arguing that even if the animal came from a licensed breeder, the video encourages illegal hunting of wildlife. She demanded Ibama present authorization for the paca’s commercialization. PL leader Sóstenes Cavalcante requested an investigation by the Ministry of Environment into the meat’s origin.

item.title: Única mulher pré-candidata à Presidência diz ser ignorada e defende renovação
item.description: Samara Martins, the sole female pre-candidate for president in Brazil's 2026 election, says she is being ignored by the media and political parties, and calls for a deep renewal in Brazilian politics. She vows to run 'for real', seeking visibility and greater female representation.

item.title: Advogado do PSD diz que 'Rio virou Gotham City' ao defender eleição direta para mandato-tampão de governador
item.description: PSD lawyer Thiago Fernandes Boverio compared Rio de Janeiro to Gotham City during STF proceedings on whether the interim governor should be elected directly or indirectly, arguing that an indirect vote would make it easier to elect the 'Joker' than 'Batman'. He advocated for direct elections, stating that voters should decide the state's future, which is currently under interim leadership following Castro's resignation and the disqualification of successors.

item.title: Lula confirma criação de conselho para tratar de minerais críticos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced the creation of the National Council for Mineral Policy and Rare Earths, linked to the Presidency of the Republic, to coordinate the exploration, industrialization, and strategic use of critical minerals in Brazil. The council will include ministries of mining, industry, defense, and foreign relations, aiming to add value to natural resources, prevent the export of raw materials, and strengthen national security amid global competition for tech-related inputs. Lula criticized regional mineral negotiations by opposition allies Flávio Bolsonaro and Ronaldo Caiado, warning such deals could lead to the 'selling of Brazil' to foreign interests.

item.title: A troca de farpas entre Gilmar Mendes e Cármen Lúcia sobre o TSE
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes criticized the TSE for the delayed judgment in the case of former governor Cláudio Castro, arguing that the prolonged process created lingering doubts about its effects. TSE President Cármen Lúcia rebutted, stating that processes are promptly scheduled after rapporteurs release them and that view requests were handled promptly, denying any negligence. Mendes also referenced a similar case involving Roraima Governor Antônio Denarium, who faces potential removal from office.

item.title: Resoluçăo do Novo obriga candidatos a apoiar impeachment de ministros do STF
item.description: The national directory of the Novo Party has established guidelines for the 2026 elections requiring its candidates to support the impeachment of Supreme Federal Court (STF) ministers. The measure aims to align the party's candidacies with a critical stance against the Judiciary, considered central to its liberal-conservative platform. The document also directs the formation of electoral alliances based on this requirement.

item.title: Após bate-boca com Eduardo Bolsonaro, Nikolas Ferreira se encontra com Flávio e fala em união: 'Mesmo time'
item.description: Following a social media clash with Eduardo Bolsonaro, federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) met with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro at a PL event in Minas Gerais, advocating for right-wing unity and stating they are on the 'same team' with the goal of winning the 2026 elections. Flávio Bolsonaro denounced the feud between his brother and Nikolas as 'anguishing', calling for rationality and reconciliation among supporters, even referencing biblical passages on forgiveness. The meeting took place during the launch of Domingos Sávio’s Senate candidacy, highlighting efforts to strengthen internal party cohesion ahead of the 2026 presidential race.
